materials_exhausted.note: Paper-local XML/PDF/OA package, extracted figure captions/PDF text, supplementary index/text, and linked database snapshots were reopened. Supplementary landing HTML files yielded no structured tables; exact unsupported graph/database-only values were not fabricated.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Primary Table 1 source-verifies DET2/DET4 names and sequences; primary results/figures source-verify antiviral IC50/max inhibition values. Exact cytotoxicity database values and unmapped dbAMP rows are preserved as cautions rather than overclaimed.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 recovered source-located plaque, RT-qPCR, Western blot, dose-response, IC50, broad cytotoxicity, and post-infection timing records with raw values/units/targets/locators.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Worker-6 accepts entry-stage and TEM viral-surface mechanism evidence with explicit limits; no unsupported molecular binding kinetics are asserted.
per_layer_decision_rationale.adjudication: The prior framework-test ticket is closed because source-reviewed artifacts now replace zero-row activity extraction and unresolved blanket database conflicts, while cautions preserve real evidence limits.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP/DRAMP exact DET2 8% and DET4 5% cell-death values are more specific than recovered local primary text, which supports less than 10% cytotoxicity; exact values are preserved as source_conflict rows.
DRAMP terminal-free/stereochemistry fields are database annotations. Primary paper supports synthetic linear peptide sequence and purity but does not independently state terminal modifications.
Two dbAMP rows are linked to the paper but locally lack peptide-specific sequence/name detail; they remain database_only_no_primary_source.

The packet has seven landing HTML assets indexed only, zero structured supplementary tables, and XML metadata reports no supplement; activity/mechanism decisions are based on primary XML/PDF/OA package and database snapshots.
TEM and post-infection timing support entry-stage/viral-surface disruption, but no unique binding kinetics or molecular target occupancy is fabricated.

adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 re-review recovered supported activity/toxicity rows, adjudicated linked database conflicts, and closed rwk-complete-test-0001 as accepted_with_cautions.
